name: Brittany Harris Gymnastics Camps
operator_name: Brown University Women's Gymnastics coaching staff
description_short: Two-day commuter gymnastics camps for girls ages 7 to 18, from beginning levels to elite, hosted by the Brown University Women's Gymnastics coaching staff with current Brown gymnasts, held at Ocean State School of Gymnastics in Lincoln, RI.
